volume noun

loudness

also turn up, turn down, turn it up, turn it down, louder, quieter

modern

M-O s.v. volume (sound)

sonus, sonī m.

noun, second declension

sound: volume

Morgan–Owens: turn up the volume is sonum augēre or intendere; turn it down, sonum minuere (our pairing).

Other words

  • vōcis quantitās — the loudness of a voice

    also used · classical · Quint. 11.3.14 (M-O s.v. volume)

Examples

  • Sonum minue: īnfāns dormit.

    Turn it down, the baby’s asleep.composed

See also mute, speaker, headphones.

SourcesLewis & Short: sonus · Lewis & Short: augeo · Lewis & Short: minuo · Lewis & Short: quantitas

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. volume (sound).
